sections.heading: Subject & Purpose
sections.content: Subject: Revised setback norms and environmental clearance applicability for commercial buildings in ecologically sensitive zones.

sections.heading: Definition of Ecologically Sensitive Zones
sections.content: Para 2: Ecologically sensitive zones include areas within 500m of lakes, rivers, and coastal regulation zones.

sections.heading: Supersession Clause
sections.content: Para 4: This GO supersedes GO No. 22/2021/LSGD dated 15.03.2021. All earlier exemptions for projects under 5,000 sq.m are hereby revoked.
